class_example: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā'ti
english_translation: (lit.) Who could analyse the meaning in detail of this brief statement stated and unexplained by the Blessed One, [who could] analyse the meaning in detail?

class_example: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā'ti
english_translation: (lit.) Who could analyse the meaning in detail of this brief statement stated and unexplained by the Blessed One, [who could] analyse the meaning in detail?

class_example: kiṃsu chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kiṃsu chetvā na socati, kissassu ekadhammassa, vadhaṃ rocesi gotamā'ti.
english_translation: Having severed what, he sleeps comfortably? Having severed what, he does not mourn? The slaughter of which one thing, O Gotama, do you consent to?

class_example: usabhaṃ pavaraṃ vīraṃ, mahesiṃ vijitāvinaṃ, anejaṃ nhātakaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
english_translation: The great sage, the hero, the distinguished noble being who, unmoved, vanquished; the perfected one, the awakened one – him do I call a brahmin (holy man).

class_example: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, māyākāro vā māyākār'antevāsī vā catumahāpathe māyaṃ vidaṃseyya.
english_translation: Just as a magician or a magician's apprentice would display an illusion at a crossroads (i.e. at the meeting of four great roads).

class_example: kumbh'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, nagar'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā. yodhetha māraṃ paññ'āvudhena, jitañ'ca rakkhe anivesano siyā.
english_translation: Having perceived this body [is fragile] like a clay pot, having set up this mind like a fortress, you should fight against death with the weapon of wisdom; one should protect the conquest and be without attachment.

class_example: tassa mukh'ādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa honti y'eva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici, yathā taṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa.
english_translation: While [the colt] is being made to do a task with the bit, there are just twistings, tricks, and vacillations in whichever way, [because] it is being made to do that task not previously done before.

class_example: kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa evam'ārocimha, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ mayaṃ lābhino'ti
english_translation: “Did we ever inform the venerable Anuruddha, 'We obtain such and such meditation attainments?”

class_example: paṭisankhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreyyāsi n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti
english_translation: Reflecting deeply: you should not eat food for fun, nor for intoxication, nor for embellishment, nor for beautification. Only for as much the continuance of this body and for nourishment of this body, and for avoiding harm to this body, and for supporting the spiritual life. Thus I will destroy the old feelings (of hunger) and not cause a new feeling (of fullness) to arise. And we will have a support, blamelessness and comfortable existence.

class_example: tassā puriso sotena vuyhamāno kāse ce'pi gaṇheyya, te palujjeyyuṃ. so tatonidānaṃ anayabyasanaṃ āpajjeyya.
english_translation: A person being carried along by its (the rivers) current, even if he grabbed hold of the grasses (growing along the bank), they would break off and because of that he would experience misfortune and disaster.
